proof_body:
by
  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
  have h2 : f ∣ Polynomial.C 2 := by
    rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    change _ ∈ Submodule.span _ {f}
    rw [← hf]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hX : f ∣ Polynomial.X := by
    rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    change _ ∈ Submodule.span _ {f}
    rw [← hf]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  have hdeg : f.natDegree = 0 := by
    have := Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd h2 (by simp)
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, f = Polynomial.C c := ⟨_, Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdeg⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hX
  have hc : c ∣ 1 := by
    refine ⟨g.coeff 1, ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 1) hg
    simpa using this
  have h1 : (1 : Polynomial ℤ) ∈ Ideal.span {(Polynomial.C 2 : Polynomial ℤ), Polynomial.X} := by
    have : (Polynomial.C c : Polynomial ℤ) ∈ Ideal.span {(Polynomial.C 2 : Polynomial ℤ), Polynomial.X} := by
      rw [show Ideal.span {(Polynomial.C 2 : Polynomial ℤ), Polynomial.X} = Submodule.span _ {Polynomial.C c} from hf]
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hc
    have h3 := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ (Polynomial.C d) this
    rwa [← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_comm d c, ← hd, Polynomial.C_1] at h3
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp h1
  have := congrArg (Polynomial.eval 0) hab
  simp at this
  omega
